records.name: tide-dike-council
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: reusable unpopulated environment background for a PC Chinese cultivation RPG, candidate only. Wide 16:9, ideally 2048x1152 or 1920x1080. Polished grounded painterly Chinese xianxia art, natural weathered stone and timber, atmospheric depth, coherent scene perspective for overlaying full-body characters later. Camera looks gently down enough to see usable ground, no extreme overhead. This is a whole interactive place, not an illustration above buttons: central and lower ground must have physically connected broad clear areas for characters to stand and move; props at sides or middle distance, do not use bottom haze to hide all walkable floor. NO people, human silhouettes, figures in distance, animals, fixed guests, enemies or statues that look like live people. NO text, pseudo-writing, UI, arrows, labels, logos, watermark, modern objects, Western fantasy architecture, sci-fi machines or giant jewels. No claim of rewards or plot outcomes. Opaque scene background.
Use supplied image as geography and style reference only. Create an adjacent view of the tidal dike council place beside this SAME ancient ferry. Preserve the shore relationship: weathered cliff and modest grey-tile timber shelter on LEFT, stone descent to old wooden landing, open real sea and grounded distant islands to RIGHT; do not change this into another continent or imperial harbor. In foreground/midground a broad modest stone dike terrace with a small practical chart table positioned upper-left of center; blank-looking paper with only nonlinguistic route lines, no text. A tidal measuring staff fixed at the seaward edge has simple unnumbered notches, several low protective tide-array stones with restrained wave grooves (no glowing runes). A small distant berth for a traditional medicine transport boat is visible along the existing shoreline. Leave THREE separate unobstructed standing areas around the chart table and a clear continuous ground path from lower foreground to ferry steps. Ordinary local working council setting, no throne hall, no crowds, no baked-in characters. Clear neutral daylight matching reference.

G4 问法席 beside the mountain-sea meeting valley. An intimate quiet place for cultivation discussion: a simple broad stone terrace, a modest Chinese timber corridor with grey tiled eaves along one side, a few plain low woven sitting mats spaced beneath the eaves, an old pine framing the scene, facing layered mountains and a glimpse of sea in the distance. One simple slightly raised plain sitting place at the back can later receive a senior cultivator as separate character overlay; NOT a throne or altar. Keep middle/lower terrace broad and uncluttered for variable peer positions and an obvious side exit along the corridor. Architecture human-scale, balanced composition, soft natural daytime light, no ceremony, wedding decor, sacrificial objects or fixed guests. Do not make a grand palace or stadium.

G6 离照洞天残存丹室. A surviving Chinese alchemical chamber within old coastal rock: weathered stone walls, modest timber supports and partially intact Chinese roof construction. Narrow shallow stone channels along BOTH SIDE EDGES divide dark dull tidal-toxic runoff into separate catch basins, visually distinct from the dry central floor, no neon green glowing fluid. Covered sealed rectangular medicinal cultivation beds occupy back-left alcoves, with plain intact lids and no visible reward herbs. A restrained medium-sized traditional Chinese bronze three-legged lidded alchemical furnace at back-right, and a weathered repairable worktable beside it with empty work surface and simple stone tools. No visible finished pills or treasure rewards. Broad clear CENTRAL dry stone floor permits a small confrontation and manual work; a rectangular Chinese post-and-lintel EXIT at middle-left leads visibly to a dry stone corridor, continuous accessible floor route. Some peripheral damage and restrained vines show age, but no rubble blocking center or exit. Side channels do not cut across the central route. Balanced readable light through high rock opening, grounded contemplative mood, not Western laboratory, no glass tubing, gears, giant orb, machinery or altar.
